thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered for service=auth-service (PD-9482). symptom=token validation 401 spike in us-east-1, rate ~x6 above baseline. first seen 2026-03-15T02:12:58Z. severity=P1. auto-page -> @Tom Nguyen (oncall). link=https://pd.example/PD-9482

PagerDuty: Incident PD-9482 created and assigned to Tom Nguyen. Escalation policy: SRE-Oncall -> SRE-Lead if not acknowledged in 5m.

Tom Nguyen: Acked. I'm oncall, looking. Can anyone pull logs for token-verify?

Ava Chen: grabbing logs now. early read: lots of 401s from gateway in us-east-1, stack shows token-verify returning "kid not found" from jwt-verify. suspect JWKS mismatch or caching.

Tom Nguyen: good. Can we confirm current jwks.json served by signing-service vs cached version?

Priya Patel: running curl against signing service and edge cache
```
curl -sS https://auth.internal.us-east-1/.well-known/jwks.json | jq '.keys[].kid'
# -> ["kid-20260314-v2", "kid-20260315-v1"]
# edge-cache shows only "kid-20260315-v1"
```

Ava Chen: yep. gateway cache had only the new kid. Tokens signed yesterday (v2) still circulating contain the older kid which signing-service should still accept but looks like the validation layer lost the older key after a deploy.

Tom Nguyen: timeline? any deploys to signing-service or jwks-publisher around 02:00Z?

Priya Patel: I see a config push on signing-service at 02:03Z that removed the fallback key accidentally. commit 7f8c3bd removed key fallback mapping. Also autoscaler restarted 3 pods at 02:08Z which likely reloaded JWKS without the older key.

Jules Romero: paging in SRE-Lead. Jules here, please @me on any rollback or mitigation steps. This is customer-impacting.

Tom Nguyen: mitigation plan: 1) restore old key into jwks.json on signing-service, 2) publish jwks to edge, 3) invalidate JWKS caches at gateways and CDN, 4) rotate if needed. I'll run step 1 and 2 now.

Priya Patel: pushing config rollback to include the removed key. patch applied to config-store (rev=r.482). running `kubectl rollout restart deploy/signing-service -n prod`.

Ava Chen: while that rolls, invalidate caches:
```
# flush local redis cache used by edge jwks cache
redis-cli -h cache-us-east-1 -n 2 --raw EVAL "return redis.call('DEL', KEYS[1])" 1 jwks:auth-service
# purge CDN jwks path
curl -X POST https://cdn.internal/purge -d '{"path":"/auth/.well-known/jwks.json"}'
```

incident-bot: Action log: Tom Nguyen applied config rollback r.482 at 02:22:11Z. signing-service pods restarted. cache flush requested.

PagerDuty: PD-9482 escalated to SRE-Lead (Jules Romero) at 02:25Z due to impact on customer tokens.

Ava Chen: after restart and purge, I'm seeing jwks.json include both kids and token-verify logs show successful key lookup for previously failing tokens. 401 rate dropping from 6x -> 1.2x baseline.

Tom Nguyen: confirmation from gateway metrics: 401s back to near normal within 90s of purge. still watching for residual errors.

Marta - CS: customer-facing: support tickets ~18 for login failures, mostly mobile apps on older tokens. I'm drafting a proactive note to affected customers with mitigation ETA.

Priya Patel: root-cause note: config change removed fallback key mapping during a config cleanup, deploys did not preserve legacy key, and cache TTL meant edge served stale jwks that lacked the restored key. human change + cache propagation = outage for tokens signed with older kid.

Jules Romero: agreed. Immediate mitigation completed. Next: begin incident brief and assign follow-ups: - postmortem (owner: Tom) - add CI gate preventing removals of active keys (owner: Priya) - add monitoring on jwks-key-drift (owner: Ava) - customer comms (owner: Marta).

Tom Nguyen: taking postmortem. I'll collect commits, deploys, and timeline. Priya can you open a PR for the CI gate? link it to PD-9482.

Priya Patel: will do. PR opened: https://git.example/repo/pull/559 - includes validation to block removal of keys referenced by tokens in the last 30d.

Ava Chen: I'll add a metric to alert when validation layer sees a token with unresolvable kid > 0.5% over 5m, so we catch sooner.

incident-bot: PD-9482 status updated: mitigation confirmed, monitoring in place. Incident will remain open until postmortem and customer comms complete.

Tom Nguyen: handing off oncall to Priya at 06:00Z UTC. Priya, please monitor for 2 hours and confirm error rates stable.

Priya Patel: acked handoff. monitoring dashboards pinned. I'll post a final verification in thread once stable for 30m.

Marta - CS: sending initial customer note now: "We've mitigated an authentication issue affecting sign-ins for some users; we're investigating root cause and will follow up with a timeline and remediation steps."

Tom Nguyen: final: error-rate baseline confirmed at 03:05Z UTC. leaving incident open for formal postmortem. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

Jules Romero: closing note: follow-up meeting scheduled 2026-03-15 10:00Z to review postmortem and CI change.

Priya Patel: final update at 03:35Z: stable for 30m, closing monitoring watch. leaving PD incident as resolved after postmortem created.

incident-bot: PD-9482 marked resolved at 03:40Z by Priya Patel.

Tom Nguyen: postmortem issue created: https://docs.internal/incidents/PD-9482-postmortem (owner Tom Nguyen).

Ava Chen: adding recommended action: set JWKS publish endpoint to include both current and N previous keys for N=2 by default, and shorter cache TTL on edges for jwks.json.

Marta - CS: will follow up with affected customers with detailed timeline after the postmortem is published.

Jules Romero: nice work everyone. we'll capture lessons and make the CI/monitoring changes mandatory.
